title: When Does Learning to Stop Help? Configuring Risk-Controlled Early Exit for Reasoning-Model Services
abstract: arXiv:2606.30852v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Early exit lowers the cost of serving a reasoning model by stopping its reasoning once a provisional answer looks final. An operator must choose between a learned stopping rule and one static token budget, and savings against full reasoning do not settle the choice. We present a procedure that decides on calibration data from the workload. It certifies both families with Learn-then-Test to one bound on the fraction of all questions that full reasoning answers correctly but early exit does not, prices provisional answers as the serving stack does, and deploys the cheapest certified candidate. Across four models and five benchmarks neither family is better throughout. At a 5% risk target the learned rule saves 10.4-17.0 percentage points more tokens than the static budget on free-form mathematics with Qwen3, with accuracy 2.4-2.9 points below full reasoning, and less on MMLU-Pro on average. translated_title: 学习式停止何时有帮助？为推理模型服务配置风险受控的提前退出机制
translated_abstract: 提前退出通过在临时答案看起来已是最终答案时停止推理，降低了推理模型的服务成本。服务运营者必须在习得的停止规则与单一静态token预算之间做出选择，而相对于完整推理的节省幅度本身并不能解决这一选择问题。我们提出了一种基于来自实际工作负载的校准数据进行决策的流程：该流程使用Learn-then-Test对两类方法进行认证，确保在所有问题中“完整推理能正确回答但提前退出无法正确回答”的比例不超过给定界限；同时按照服务栈的方式对临时答案进行定价，并部署其中成本最低的已认证候选方案。在四个模型和五个基准测试上，没有任何一类方法始终占优。在5%的风险目标下，使用Qwen3处理自由格式数学任务时，习得的停止规则比静态预算多节省10.4-17.0个百分点的token，准确率仅比完整推理低2.4-2.9个百分点，而在MMLU-Pro上平均节省较少。哪一类方法成本更低也会随场景变化（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于工作负载校准数据的部署决策流程，通过Learn-then-Test以可证明的风险界限同时认证学习式停止规则与静态token预算两类提前退出方案并部署成本最低者，实验表明两类方案在不同模型与任务上各有优势、无普适胜者。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a calibration-based deployment procedure that uses Learn-then-Test to certify both learned stopping rules and static token budgets under a provable risk bound and deploys the cheapest certified candidate, showing that neither early-exit family dominates across models and benchmarks.
